summary.text: Raymond Hull is a Democratic state representative from District 6 who took office on January 4, 2011 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Hull earned a B.S. in Criminal Justice from Roger Williams University in 1992 and an M.A. in Administration of Justice from Anna Maria College in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a police officer, reaching the rank of sergeant in the Records Bureau of the Providence Police Department.
